MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The powered USB 3.0 hub fits my interest in connecting existing devices because it could accommodate my networking adapters and other peripherals without limiting them to USB 2.0 speeds.",
    "The hub's individual switches seem useful for controlling connected accessories, although ten ports may be more than I need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The USB 2.0 hub looks relevant, but it could limit my USB 3.0 Ethernet adapter, so the connection speed matters more to me than simply adding ports.",
    "A tablet and streaming stick do not help me connect the devices I already own, which is the clearest need reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "My past headset, display cable, and tablet mount purchases do not mean I currently need earbuds, an HDMI cable, or a tripod.",
    "The hard drive, optical drive, and flash drive would need a specific storage or media task to justify a purchase; I have no such need now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat general computer accessories as interchangeable, even when they solve very different problems.",
    "An older purchase seems to be taken as a reason to buy another related accessory, without a clear current use for it."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchase was a USB 3.0 Ethernet adapter, so compatibility with that adapter and preserving its connection speed matter to me.",
    "My purchases are infrequent and tied to particular tasks; a broadly useful accessory is not enough to make me choose it now.",
    "Improving connections for my existing equipment feels more relevant than adding another device or starting an unrelated upgrade."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in connectivity, but stretched it into general electronics purchases without enough attention to compatibility or an immediate need."
}
